item.title: Week 7 Worklog
item.description:
Internship period: 21/09/2026 - 26/09/2026

Week 7 Objectives:

  • Follow an order across processing components.
  • Establish logs, metrics, and alarms to support incident detection.

Tasks Completed:

Date Task Reference Material
21/09/2026 Define the information recorded at each step: orderId, eventId, correlationId, state, and processing time. Observability design notes
22/09/2026 Add structured logs and propagate correlationId through the API, events, and consumer while limiting sensitive data in logs. Amazon CloudWatch Logs
23/09/2026 Write Logs Insights queries to follow individual orders and summarize error categories. CloudWatch Logs Insights
25/09/2026 Create a dashboard for Lambda errors, duration, throttles, queue backlog, and oldest-message age. Amazon CloudWatch
26/09/2026 Configure experimental alarms for processing failures and dead-letter messages; inject controlled failures to verify alarm behavior. CloudWatch alarms

Week 7 Achievements:

  • Established log correlation across components using order identifiers and correlationId.
  • Created initial dashboards and alarms for detecting failures and processing backlogs.
